scenarios.title: Retain and migrate authored image coverage
plannedActions: Create a separate synthetic timeline project through POST /v1/projects and read its empty snapshot and events
Create a zero-owned direction and dormant anchored cue, then acquire its edit lease
Reject a nonzero offset into the zero-owned direction and read unchanged snapshot/events
Reject appending dialogue without resolving the cue and read unchanged snapshot/events
Repair the rejected append ID with its cue edit and read exact receipt/snapshot/events
Prepend a 500 ms direction with the shifted cue and read exact receipt/snapshot/events
Reject legacy coverage crossing the anchor from before and read unchanged snapshot/events
Reject legacy coverage overlapping the earlier anchored cue and read unchanged snapshot/events
Accept legacy coverage meeting the anchor exactly and read receipt/snapshot/events
Acquire legacy cue lease and migrate to overlapping anchored coverage, then read receipt/snapshot/events
Replay the exact migration and verify unchanged receipt/snapshot/events
Acquire prefix and dialogue leases, reject collapse with stale cues, and read unchanged snapshot/events
Repair the rejected collapse ID with companion cue operations and read receipt/snapshot/events
Replay the exact collapse and verify unchanged receipt/snapshot/events
Restore the tombstoned dialogue with resolved image coverage and read receipt/snapshot/events
expectedOutcomes: Zero-owned direction coverage is dormant at [0,0], resolves to [0,750] after appending a 1000 ms dialogue, shifts to [500,1250] after prepending 500 ms, collapses to dormant and resolves again after restoration; seven accepted edits match independent item/version/timing/receipt/event expectations.

Five exact 409 cue_anchor or cue_timing rejections leave the complete public document snapshot excluding leases and complete event stream unchanged. Legacy coverage crossing an anchored cue from either side is rejected, an exact boundary is accepted, and migration to source anchors permits the explicit overlap.

Rejected append and collapse command IDs accept the repaired companion operations without an extra event from failure; exact migration and collapse replays preserve receipts and saved document snapshot excluding leases and complete history.

associations.rationale: The real public command transaction recomputes scene entry starts and validates dormant, anchored and legacy image coverage against the complete edited graph.
associations.uncertainty: No claim of the 24-hour limit rejection, lease expiry, native rendering, concurrent races, crash durability or measured source counters.
